name: 33-custom-apps
description: apps: (before screens:) replaces the default apps, in order; a screen without app: belongs to the first app; toYaml writes apps: back.
input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
apps:
  - id: garden
    title: "Garden: back"
  - id: home
    title: Home
  - id: empty
screens:
  - id: g
    widgets:
      - {type: clock}
  - id: h
    app: home
    widgets:
      - {type: price}

expect.yaml:
